picks.title: 1818: Why Nothing in This World Satisfies Us
picks.summary: Voltaire — the greatest writer of the French Enlightenment wrote that there is a dim flame burning in every heart — an intuition that somewhere there is a home, a happiness that is real and lasting.  We spend our lives chasing it in bodies, children, homes, wealth, relationships. And it never quite delivers. In this episode Raghunath and Kaustubha explore that intuition, what covers that dim light, and how the sacred texts of the bhakti tradition say it can be uncovered. Srimad Bhagavatam 10.40.10-24   ******************************************************************** LOVE THE PODCAST? WE AR
picks.reason: Explores human dissatisfaction and bhakti tradition's path to lasting happiness.

picks.title: 82. War Night 16 | Internal Sabotage by Shalya | Psychological War on Karna | Karna's 2 Curses
picks.summary: The night of the 16th day of Mahabharat War presents the Kaurava high command with a massive logistical and strategic crisis. To have any chance of defeating Arjun, Commander-in-Chief Karna requires a charioteer whose tactical genius matches that of Lord Krishna. Duryodhan identifies King Shalya of Madra as the only viable candidate. However, asking a royal, high-born monarch to drive the chariot of a man labeled a "Suta" (charioteer’s caste) is a monumental diplomatic insult. picks.reason: Deep analysis of Mahabharata characters and dharma in war context.

picks.title: 1816: Krishna, Vishnu and the Mystery of the Avatars
picks.summary: Most Vedic literature speaks from a perspective within this universe. But some reveal that this universe is just a tiny bubble among countless others — and invite us to view our place in existence from outside. Depending on which angle we look from, either Vishnu or Krishna will appear to be the origin of the Avatars. Raghunath and Kaustubha explore that question alongside Akrūra's extraordinary vision in the Yamuna — seeing Vishnu in the water, coming out to find Krishna on the chariot, going back in and seeing Vishnu again. When I am seeing you, what have I not seen? Srimad Bhagavatam 10.39.
picks.reason: Explores Vishnu and Krishna as origins of Avatars with Vedic cosmology.

picks.showTitle: The Sadhguru Podcast - Of Mystics and Mistakes
picks.title: #1532 -  Pandit Dhirendra Shastri & Sadhguru
picks.summary:
Bageshwar Dham’s Peethadhishwar Pandit Dhirendra Shastri spent time in the consecrated spaces of Isha Yoga Center Coimbatore and met Sadhguru on 22 July. During a conversation with Sadhguru, he shared his experience of meditating in the powerful presence of Dhyanalinga and spending time in the abode of Linga Bhairavi adjacent to Isha Yoga Center. He explored a number of topics with Sadhguru including Santana Dharma, Yoga and meditation, how one can turn inward and whether one can progress on the spiritual path without the guidance of a live Guru.

picks.summary: Swami Sarvapriyananda reads and discusses the Gospel of Sri Ramakrishna. picks.title: #1533 -  What It Means to Have Sadhguru as One's Guru
picks.summary:
